name: Bus Open Data Service regional GTFS timetables (south_east, east_anglia, east_midlands)
publisher: Department for Transport (Bus Open Data Service)
variables: registered bus timetables (GTFS: stops, routes, trips, stop_times, calendars)
frequency: Daily regeneration of the regional GTFS files
latest_period: Feeds downloaded 5 Nov 2026 (services valid from 5 Nov 2026); modelled day Tue 17 Nov 2026
api_notes: Regional GTFS zips download without an API key: https://data.bus-data.dft.gov.uk/timetable/download/gtfs-file/<region>/ (region e.g. south_east, east_anglia, east_midlands). Bedfordshire's operators (Stagecoach East, Arriva Beds & Bucks, Grant Palmer etc.) are mostly in the south_east file (about 2,200 Bedfordshire/Luton stops); east_anglia and east_midlands add cross-boundary routes. Used in pipeline/fetch_travel.py with OpenTripPlanner 2.8.1 (Docker batch).
limitations: Bus only (no rail). Published schedules, not punctuality; demand-responsive and works services often missing; a route can appear in more than one regional file. Future services (resort shuttles, EWR) are not in it.
quality: Statutory operator registrations published by DfT; data-quality varies by operator
why_it_matters: The bus network for LSOA-to-site public transport journey times (travel_lsoa: arrive by 08:30, home after a 22:30 shift).

name: OpenStreetMap Bedfordshire extract (street network for walk, cycle, car routing)
variables: roads, paths, cycleways, access restrictions, speed limits
api_notes: https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/united-kingdom/england/bedfordshire-latest.osm.pbf; used by OpenTripPlanner (UK tag mapping) in pipeline/fetch_travel.py.
limitations: Ceremonial-county clip: walking/driving just over the Herts/Bucks/Cambs/Northants border is not routable. Car speeds are free-flow from tags/defaults (no congestion).
quality: Crowd-sourced; road network in England is near-complete
why_it_matters: Walk access to stops and car/cycle journey times to the Kempston Hardwick site. Licence ODbL 1.0 (attribution: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors).

name: Rail timetables for Bedfordshire lines (Marston Vale, Thameslink, EMR) - hand-built GTFS
publisher: London Northwestern Railway; Thameslink (GTR); East Midlands Railway (published timetables)
frequency: Timetable changes each May and December
api_notes: No openly licensed, registration-free GB rail GTFS was found (the RDG/Network Rail timetable feeds need registration). pipeline/travel/rail_gtfs/ holds a small GTFS: Marston Vale trains transcribed from the LNR PDF by pipeline/travel/make_rail_gtfs.py; Thameslink and EMR Bedford-Luton as frequencies.txt headways; station coordinates from NaPTAN (https://naptan.api.dft.gov.uk/v1/access-nodes?dataFormat=csv&atcoAreaCodes=910).
limitations: Thameslink/EMR departures are approximate (regular headways, peak fast trains omitted); Marston Vale bus replacement during East West Rail works is not modelled; no other rail lines.
why_it_matters: The site sits next to Kempston Hardwick station; Luton/Leagrave/Flitwick residents reach it by changing at Bedford, so rail determines Luton's public transport catchment.
